common_prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create realistic, production-quality UI design for the existing independent, non-commercial Roco World Handbook native iOS App. This is a proposed redesign, not a running App screenshot.
Target dimensions: one 780 x 844 design board containing TWO adjacent complete 390 x 844 app-content screens, left Tools, right Settings. Treat these as two pages of ONE coherent concept, not multiple ideas. Preserve natural mobile proportions, readable compact typography, purposeful real imagery, no clipped content. Output App content only: no phone/device body, bezel, OS status bar, notch, Dynamic Island, clock, signal/battery, home indicator, browser chrome, device mask or external shadow.
Reference images in order: 1 actual live NRC Wiki mobile homepage image cards; 2 actual Wiki season archive with large paired creature artwork in inset white frames; 3 actual Wiki skill gallery with black/gold header and framed spell images; 4 current App Tools; 5 current App Settings. References 1-3 ground the visual language and art. References 4-5 establish existing functionality and the text-heavy layout to improve; do not preserve their plain green text-row treatment.
User brief: observe the actual Wiki and make the App substantially MORE IMAGE-LED, with meaningful visible image borders/frames, stronger game identity and LESS TEXT. Current regular text was too large. Small, polished product typography: page titles 18-20 px, tool labels/body 14-16 px, tiny supporting text only where necessary. No large marketing hero title, no repeated explanatory subtitles under every Tool. At most two fonts, closely match playful compact Wiki headings plus readable rounded platform body. Do not fake imagery with letters, ASCII, emoji, blank placeholders, or generic outline icons as the dominant visual. Use Roco creature art, illustrated game-object/skill images and properly fitted decorative frames. Imagery should carry about 55-65% of Tools content. Use real illustrated borders with depth/inset edges/corner or crest details, not just a hairline stroke around each text row. Restrain decoration so text remains readable.
Only existing functionality:
LEFT Tools title '工具'. Exactly seven existing destination labels, once each: '赛季档案', '特性图鉴', '孵蛋组别', '游戏描述', '活动时间轴', '穿搭灵感', '我的收藏'. Make their pictures distinct and semantically useful. Preserve them all without verbose descriptions, fake progress, fake counts, quests or new workflows.
RIGHT Settings title '设置'. Compact useful controls, NOT a login/profile screen: '外观' with '精灵图鉴布局' choices '三列' / '双列' / '列表'; '技能展示' choices '双列' / '三列' / '详细描述'. Then '我的收藏', '图鉴信息', '检查图鉴更新', '恢复内置图鉴', '来源与许可'. Preserve a short recovery note '恢复保留收藏与笔记'. Small footer '独立 · 非商业 · 非官方' and version '1.2.0 (3)' are sufficient. Use a small illustrated book/crest/art frame to give Settings game character, while keeping controls clear. Do not add sound/music, notification toggles, account/login, cloud sync, cache clearing, payment, unsupported language controls, or fake profile statistics.
Keep four product navigation tabs '精灵' / '技能' / '工具' / '设置' on each screen, with the respective page selected. Entire interactive tiles/actions should plausibly allow >=44 logical px hit areas. Every page should look like a coherent native handbook surface rather than a website screenshot.
Current date anchor: 2026-10-25, Asia/Shanghai. Do not invent freshness dates, event announcements, seasons beyond the App's existing data, or timers. Dates need not appear. Do not use the Wiki's web login, site-management features, footer groups or unrelated tools. No extra feature inventory or calls to action. Do not print a concept name or an option number on the board.
General UI craft: use hierarchy, alignment and spacing intentionally. Group Settings controls on one integrated surface with lightweight separation; no cards nested inside cards. A richly framed image navigation tile is a standalone object and may have its own picture border. Use subtle shadows sparingly and maintain strong text contrast. This design should feel like a polished, image-rich Roco game handbook adapted from the actual provided Wiki, not a generic SaaS dashboard.

concepts.name: Blue codex gallery
concepts.direction: Use the homepage's cool blue/slate/lavender image gallery language. Left: one shallow illustrated season card across the width, then a compact two-column gallery of the other six destinations with large Roco art or skill/object imagery, small corner titles and unmistakable inset slate-blue/gold picture frames. Small labels sit within/alongside images, no subtitles. Right: a pale cool-blue handbook panel with one small framed book emblem, three miniature image previews for each layout choice, then quiet short rows for the remaining Settings. Strong visual connection across both pages. Borders should feel like real illustrated display cases, not seven pill-shaped text rows.

concepts.name: Season postcard album
concepts.direction: Use the season archive's ivory picture mats, muted purple seasonal artwork and restrained antique-gold framing. Left: compose an illustrated album with seven varied but aligned postcard-like picture entrances: an emphasized wide seasonal illustration, a paired feature/egg image row, a narrow illustrated description entry, a paired activity/outfit image row, and a compact illustrated favorites strip. Keep concise labels printed on tiny frame tabs, no poetic prose, compact titles. Right: a compact open-handbook-inspired Settings surface with a modest side illustration occupying only a small area, layout previews as miniature framed specimen sheets, useful controls grouped like labeled bookmark sections. Express a genuine illustration/frame system, not the current green plain rounded cards.

concepts.name: Magic codex workbench
concepts.direction: Use the skill gallery's charcoal/navy-and-gold framed header plus cream working surface. Left: a compact magical workbench/codex with three columns of medium illustrated medallion or square framed tool images for six tools, plus a wider small favorites tray; all seven labels readable. Distinct blue/purple skill-art interiors, substantial dark-gold beveled borders, very restrained star/rune ornament derived from the Wiki. No huge banner or statistics. Right: a matching cream settings console under a short dark title rail, two sets of framed miniature layout choices, then compact practical rows and a small decorative book/crest anchor. Keep gold accents localized, light overall background, lots of breathing room, modest 14-16 px UI type. Avoid generic desktop settings lists or fake audio/game options.
